headline: Contested Fronts Shift as Fighting Cools
war_summary: The latest ledger keeps the war without a victor, while the principal turnover belt shows a mixed report. Godcrofts remains the busiest board, logging 56 events in 24 hours and six in the latest two-hour window, though all nine strategic bases currently stand Colonial; casualty and enlistment rates have turned upward in that short spell. Fisherman’s Row, formerly the sharpest revolving front, has recorded 30 daily events but none in two hours, indicating a lull after recent exchanges. Weathered Expanse remains divided four Warden to five Colonial, with 30 events in the day and six in six hours, though none in the latest two-hour cut. Stlican Shelf now stands seven Warden to two Colonial, with 26 daily events and two in the last two hours. Stonecradle is still split four Warden to five Colonial and has three fresh events amid accelerating casualty and enlistment rates. Mooring County remains heavily Warden-held at eleven to one; its nine daily events are older, but the latest casualty figures show a renewed surge. Other sectors report heavy losses without comparable base turnover.
